dependencies.title: POC: acceptance gaps and demo
dependencies.description:
Close the gaps between the shipped app (tze_hud_app + production.toml) and docs/scope.md 'POC acceptance', prove each bullet with a headless end-to-end test in Linux CI, build a single demo agent, and run the checklist on the owner's Windows overlay.

Governing spec: docs/scope.md 'POC acceptance' (Portal, Zones, Widgets, Tiles, Override, Idle); docs/api.md; docs/invariants.md §1, §3, §4, §5, §9; docs/vision.md 'The real-estate lifecycle'.

Survey verdict (2026-10-03): Portal partial (never run end to end); Zones TTL/delay yes, action buttons never drawn; Widgets missing from the shipped artifact; Tiles partial (orphan badge never drawn, reap wipes same-namespace MCP content); Override no (no safe-mode entry, MCP bypasses safe mode, tiles/portals not dismissable); Idle partial (notification countdown and composer caret redraw at 60 fps).

## Success Criteria
1. tests/integration/poc_acceptance.rs proves every acceptance bullet except pixel/idle claims, headless in CI.
2. Safe mode and dismiss win over a hung agent on every surface (MCP, gRPC, portal).
3. The shipped exe has its widgets; a widget update re-rasterizes only that widget.
4. Static content on screen costs no frames between events.
5. examples/poc_demo drives zones, widgets, tiles and override against the live app.
6. The owner runs the full checklist on the Windows overlay and it passes.
dependencies.design:
Order: Wave A (independent fixes) and B1 (headless harness, T7's guard) first; then overlay behavior (B2-B8); then C1 (remaining acceptance tests), C2 demo, C3 Windows smoke; then human sign-off and the owner-host run.
Cohesion override: more than 9 children because the coordinator required one epic per area and the POC spans six independent acceptance bullets with distinct risk and sign-off gates.
Decisions (coordinator 2026-10-03): fix docs/api.md to say zone:notification-area (don't rename the zone); safe-mode global hotkey configurable, default Ctrl+Shift+F12, RegisterHotKey; tile/portal dismiss = token-styled close button on hover in chrome (visual sign-off is needs-human); 're-renders only that widget' = re-rasterizes only that widget's SVG, scope.md wording updated; resident tile agent gets its own agent entry (allow ["tiles"]) via pairing once T6 lands, tests use agents.toml injection; stale PRs #658 #659 #1193 #1216 #1218 #1219 already closed.
Gating rule: anything requiring a real Windows desktop/visual check, real install on the owner's host, or an owner taste call is a separate needs-human bead.

hud-jm8nq.8.title: Idle with content on screen: no frames between events
hud-jm8nq.8.description:
Goal: a notification counting down to its fade and a focused composer cost no frames between events, AND overlay click capture (notification actions, the x, widget hover, portal clicks) keeps working when the HUD is idle.

Why: `has_inflight_animation` treats a notification counting down as in flight (crates/tze_hud_compositor/src/renderer/animation.rs:738-747), so a visible notification redraws at 60 fps for its whole TTL; the composer caret renders at 60 fps (renderer/mod.rs:1583-1601) instead of waking every 530 ms (image_cache.rs:137), pinned by `idle_render_gate_renders_for_composer_echo_and_caret_blink` (renderer/tests.rs:9755). Overlay passthrough flips only in about_to_wait (crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/windowed/mod.rs:817-821 -> windowed/hittest.rs:184-244, GetCursorPos): it works today only because the 60 fps redraw polls it, so fixing idle alone breaks clicks. The two changes must land together.

Non-goals: damage-rect presentation; the Windows CPU/click verification itself (needs-human sign-off bead).
Governing spec: docs/scope.md 'POC acceptance' Idle and Zones (action reaches hud_input); CLAUDE.md rule 'Idle costs ~nothing'; docs/invariants.md §1. Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (content identical to main@1eb8f7cb, the merge of PR #1245); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey that produced this bead is not persisted; everything needed is in this bead.
hud-jm8nq.8.design:
Files: crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/windowed/hittest.rs:184-244; windowed/mod.rs:817-821, :1683-1731 (TtlDeadline min); windowed/wake.rs; crates/tze_hud_compositor/src/renderer/animation.rs:738-747; renderer/mod.rs:1583-1601; renderer/tests.rs:9755 (rewrite).
Approach: (1) input capture: arm a low-rate cursor poll (e.g. 30 Hz via WaitUntil) only while interactive hit regions exist and the window is in passthrough; on a hit, flip passthrough off. (WH_MOUSE_LL hook is the heavier alternative; prefer the poll.) (2) idle: a countdown is not in flight; expose `next_animation_deadline()` (fade start, next caret toggle) and fold it into the TtlDeadline min.
Tests added: `cursor_poll_armed_only_with_hit_regions` (wake-source unit), `notification_countdown_is_not_inflight_animation`, `caret_blink_wakes_at_toggle_not_every_frame`, `idle_with_notification_renders_only_at_fade` (frame counter over a TestClock window). Rewritten: `idle_render_gate_renders_for_composer_echo_and_caret_blink`. Kept: `sixty_seconds_of_static_idle_has_zero_runtime_wakeups` (wake.rs:524), `idle_render_gate_skips_static_scene_renders_on_change_or_animation`, crates/tze_hud_runtime/tests/idle_efficiency_counters.rs (idle counters stay zero with no hit regions).
Windows click/CPU verification lives in the POC needs-human sign-off bead.
hud-jm8nq.8.acceptance_criteria:
1. `cargo test -p tze_hud_runtime cursor_poll_armed_only_with_hit_regions` passes; with no hit regions the idle counters (crates/tze_hud_runtime/tests/idle_efficiency_counters.rs) stay zero.
2. `just test` passes including notification_countdown_is_not_inflight_animation, caret_blink_wakes_at_toggle_not_every_frame and idle_with_notification_renders_only_at_fade (filter: `HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE=1 cargo test -p tze_hud_compositor <name>`).
3. `cargo test -p tze_hud_runtime sixty_seconds_of_static_idle_has_zero_runtime_wakeups` passes.
4. POC headless zone tests (`cargo test -p integration --test poc_acceptance poc_notification_action_reaches_hud_input`) still pass.
5. Gates, run once before handoff (quiet): `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo test -p <crate>` for every touched crate (for tze_hud_compositor use `just test`, which sets HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE=1; never run `cargo test -p tze_hud_compositor` bare, it deadlocks headless); `just ci` green.

hud-bstmy.5.6.title: Decide: delete the never-activated freeze, or keep and wire it (invariant 3)
hud-bstmy.5.6.description:
Escalation (hard gate: amends invariant 3 wording, docs/invariants.md). One decision.

Facts: SharedState.freeze_active (protocol session.rs:191) is never set true outside tests (session_server tests.rs:2251). runtime shell/freeze.rs (1,137 lines) is referenced only by re-exports and 3 portal integration tests (text_stream_portal_{coalescing,cadence,governance} import FreezeQueue). The protocol freeze queue (session_server/freeze_queue.rs 217; mutations.rs:345-~420; mod.rs:413-426) can never fill. Invariant 3 currently covers safe mode and dismiss; freeze is described alongside.

Options:
A. Delete freeze (runtime shell/freeze.rs, protocol freeze queue, freeze_active) and reword invariant 3 to 'Safe mode and dismiss'. About -3,000 lines. Lands after T7 (hud-lirh2) retargets the portal tests.
B. Keep and wire it: a viewer chord/hotkey freezes agent mutations (queued, applied on unfreeze), drawn in chrome; add a behavior test. About +300 lines.
C. Status quo: leave dead code as is.

Recommendation: A. No current user, the POC Override criterion is satisfied by safe mode (hud-jm8nq.10), and 'prefer deleting over generalizing'. Consequences: A shrinks invariant 3 scope (no freeze promise); B adds a feature the vision does not require; C keeps 3k dead lines and a misleading invariant claim.

Default if unanswered: C (status quo, no code or invariant change).

Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (same content as main@1eb8f7cb); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey is not persisted; this bead is self-contained.
hud-bstmy.5.6.design: [escalate] Freeze: deleting it amends invariant 3 -> needs-human (decisions.md T8 #3). Answer with one word: A, B or C. On A: the coordinator files an implementation bead under T8.2b depending on hud-lirh2.11 (T7 complete), with acceptance: fmt/clippy/test for runtime+protocol+integration, `git grep -nE 'FreezeQueue|freeze_active' -- crates tests` empty, invariants.md §3 reworded.

hud-bstmy.8.6.title: Decide: required-check ruleset changes (boot jobs, Windows clippy, pixel_readback gating)
hud-bstmy.8.6.description:
Escalation (hard gate: owner account/ruleset change on GitHub 'main merge queue', ci.yml:8-11). One decision covering a single ruleset edit window.

Proposed changes:
1. Delete required jobs production-boot-vertical-slice (ci.yml:322) and canonical-app-production-boot (ci.yml:365): test-unit (ci.yml:207-211, --workspace --all-targets) already runs both tests; each recompiles the workspace and reinstalls Mesa.
2. Replace clippy-windows-gnu (ci.yml:143-180, mingw cross) with `cargo clippy --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc` inside windows.yml windows-build (native MSVC runner from T6 step 1).
3. pixel_readback: test-gpu-pixel-readback (ci.yml:580-622) is continue-on-error and gates nothing: make it blocking inside test-unit, or move it to the weekly perf lane.
vertical_slice stays (it is a required check) and the weekly perf lane stays.

Options:
A. Apply 1+2+3(blocking in test-unit); owner edits the ruleset in the same window as the PR. About -135 YAML lines, 2-3 fewer full compiles and Mesa installs per PR.
B. Apply 1+2 only; move pixel_readback to the weekly lane.
C. Status quo.

Recommendation: A (after the T8 llvmpipe recipe shows pixel_readback is stable on Mesa). Consequences: A/B require a ruleset edit or merges block on missing checks; C keeps the duplicate compile cost per PR.

Default if unanswered: C (no change to CI or the ruleset).

Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (same content as main@1eb8f7cb); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey is not persisted; this bead is self-contained.
